{{Top|leg}}
A '''Class Two multi-phasic robot''' was a second degree [[Droid/Legends|droid]] used for information retrieval and analysis, [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] duties, along with other technical uses. The multi-phasic portion of this droid incorporated a ''personality'' and was able to employ a decision-making process which was not part of its original programming. This droid also incorporated intellectual and emotional capacities roughly equalling organic [[Sentience/Legends|sentients]].

[[Vuffi Raa]] was a Class Two multi-phasic robot.
